subject: general
question: ______ is the international air carrier of India and handles foreign traffic, which includes both cargo and passenger services.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Air India.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **national airline of India**, Air India, has its main office in **New Delhi.**
 
• **Talace Private Limited**, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Tata Sons, is the owner of it.
 
• **102 local and foreign destinations** are served by the fleet of Airbus and Boeing aircraft operated by Air India.
 
• The airline's hub and numerous focal cities around India are located at I**ndira Gandhi International Airport **in New Delhi.
 
• With an **18.6% market share,** Air India is the** biggest foreign airline **operating from India.
 
• On **July 11, 2014,** the airline joined** Star Alliance **as its **27th member.**
 
• **J. R. D. Tata **established the airline **Tata Airlines in 1932.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pawan Hans:**

 
 
• Located in **Noida, Delhi-National Capital Region,** India, Pawan Hans Ltd is a central public sector undertaking.
 
• The Government of India's** Ministry of Civil Aviation **is the owner.
 
 
 
• **Dove Airlines:**
 
 
• **​**Dove Airlines was a charter airline operating out of **Kolkata, India.**
 
 
 
• **Taj Air:**
 
 
• The Tata Group, which is the owner of **TajAir,** was the first to introduce **aviation** to India more than 80 years ago.
 
• It is listed as a **non-scheduled operato**r with the Directorate General of Civil Aviation.
